The numbers for "EMERALD MINE 9X" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
5055.headline: A close look at the prizes

5057.body:
About three-quarters of the tickets for "EASY MONEY" have been sold. The game is past the halfway point of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

The numbers for "EASY MONEY" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
5057.headline: How much has sold

5059.body:
"THE CASH WHEEL" offers a top prize of $1 million and fourteen prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward the smaller prizes. Games shaped like this pay out often, in small amounts. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

Every line of THE CASH WHEEL's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
5059.headline: How prizes are split

5060.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "FIND THE 7S", about a quarter are still unsold. The game is near the end of its run, with zero of eight top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If you play "FIND THE 7S" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
5060.headline: Early stage or late

5063.body:
"CA$H IN HAND" is down to two top prizes after a $2 million winner was claimed last week. The game started with four top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

The numbers for "CA$H IN HAND" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
5063.headline: Another top prize was claimed
